text: I was first conscious that she was kissing me, and then my eyes seemed to wake on a sudden to their sense of outward things, and I knew that I was looking mechanically straight before me at the prospect of the lake. “It is late,” I heard her whisper. “It will be dark in the plantation.” She shook my arm and repeated, “Marian! it will be dark in the plantation.” “Give me a minute longer,” I said—“a minute, to get better in.” I was afraid to trust myself to look at her yet, and I kept my eyes fixed on the view. It WAS late.
